sources.title: Multimodal Prompt Transformer with Hybrid Contrastive Learning for ...
sources.snippet: Finally, we used the Hybrid Contrastive Learning (HCL) strategy to optimize the model's ability to handle labels with few samples. This strategy uses unsupervised contrastive learning to improve the representation ability of multimodal fusion and supervised contrastive learning to mine the information of labels with few samples.
